name: AdGuard Home
tagline: Network-wide DNS server that blocks ads and trackers.
description: AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads and trackers, acting as a DNS server that re-routes tracking domains to a black hole for every device on your network.
postInstall: Open it on its Setup port and follow the wizard: create the administrator account, and keep the web interface on port 80 and DNS on port 53, the ports HSI published.
After the wizard, open it on its Web UI port.
Point your router's DNS setting, or each device's, to this server's address to filter your network.
